text.en: Reviewers consistently commend the Tallaght veterinary team for their kind, polite, and reassuring approach. Clients single out vets Sonya and Robyn for taking ample time to answer questions and explain procedures thoroughly during consultations. Pet owners emphasize that the welcoming reception and nursing care make every visit smooth and stress-free.

Pet owners appreciate the tender handling of young kittens during first vaccinations and the calming attention given to anxious dogs. Clients highlight touching compassionate gestures following the loss of a pet, such as receiving sympathy cards with fur keepsakes and paw print mementos. Reviewers feel confident that their companion animals are treated with genuine respect and warmth.

Clients report successful medical outcomes for multi-pet neutering, accident recoveries, and urgent emergency canine surgeries. Reviewers praise the veterinary team for acting swiftly in critical moments and providing clear pre- and post-operative guidance. Pet parents feel reassuringly supported by the clinic's comprehensive diagnostic and surgical capabilities.

q.en: Can Village Vets Tallaght perform emergency pet surgeries?

a.en: Yes, clients praise the team for providing immediate clinical care and successful emergency surgical procedures when urgent situations arose.

q.en: Does the clinic offer commemorative keepsakes after pet loss?

a.en: Yes, pet owners report receiving thoughtful condolence cards containing paw prints and keepsake vials of pet hair from the staff.

q.en: Is parking easy to find when visiting the practice?

a.en: Yes, visitors appreciate the large free car park situated within the Lidl complex on Cookstown Estate Road.

q.en: Are young kittens handled gently during initial vaccinations?

a.en: Yes, reviewers note that veterinarians take time to ensure young kittens remain calm and stress-free during early health checks.
